description: Brands with affiliate or ambassador programs, from Chockstone's shared library (seeded, found by reading brands' own sites, and added by creators). Defaults to the creator's interests (creator_profile_get). Each says how it's joined, its commission and follower minimum when the brand states them, and this workspace's application if there is one. Missing a brand? brand_program_add with its site.

interests.description: Default: the profile's interests; [] (or an empty value) for every brand

max_min_followers.description: Leave out brands that ask for more followers than this

query.description: Words in the brand's name or site

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: brand_programs_search
title: Find brand programs
